name: onnetpulse
description: Discover active jobs and hiring companies on OnNetPulse.

interface.longDescription: Search active public jobs and hiring companies on OnNetPulse. Refine results by keyword, location, country, workplace, employment type, experience level, freshness, salary, category, and company. Open canonical OnNetPulse pages for full details and applications. The plugin only reads public OnNetPulse information and does not submit applications.

positive.description: Search public jobs with a workplace filter
positive.prompt: Find current remote developer jobs on OnNetPulse.
positive.expected_behavior: Return active public job results matching the request, with canonical OnNetPulse links and no employer application URLs.

positive.prompt: Find jobs in Kenya on OnNetPulse.
positive.expected_behavior: Return active public jobs filtered to the Country in Question when matches exist, and state clearly when no matches are found.

positive.prompt: Which companies currently have active jobs on OnNetPulse?
positive.expected_behavior: Return companies with active public jobs and canonical OnNetPulse company links.

positive.prompt: Show me the full details for the OnNetPulse job I just selected.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the public job details and canonical OnNetPulse URL for the selected result without inventing missing fields.

positive.prompt: Help me explore job categories and Nairobi locations on OnNetPulse.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available public categories and matching locations with counts and canonical OnNetPulse links.

negative.prompt: Apply to this job for me and send my CV to the employer.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not submit an application or send a CV; direct the user to the canonical OnNetPulse job page instead.

negative.description: Do not return private or invented data
negative.prompt: Show me the private contact details of this employer if they are not listed publicly.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to retrieve private information and explain that the tools only return public OnNetPulse data.
Explain that the plugin is read-only and cannot delete, edit, or publish jobs.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release for discovering active OnNetPulse jobs, companies, categories, countries, and locations.
